// SMILES string of the molecule.

}) => any;

// SMILES string of the molecule.

}) => any;

// SMILES string of the molecule.

}) => any;

ph?: number

// SMILES string of the molecule.

// SMILES string of the molecule.

type get_scaffold = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;
